name: naijakart-world-preview
description: Renders the generated Naija Kart world and a race replay to video (no artists, no engine licence).

scripts.setup: mkdir -p public/vendor public/fonts && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js public/vendor/three.module.js && cp -r node_modules/three/examples/jsm public/vendor/jsm && cp node_modules/@fontsource/baloo-2/files/baloo-2-latin-800-normal.woff2 public/fonts/baloo-800.woff2 && cp node_modules/@fontsource/baloo-2/files/baloo-2-latin-700-normal.woff2 public/fonts/baloo-700.woff2 && cp index.html public/index.html
